title: Common-stage vanishing of finitely many raw cartesian derived classes
statement: Let k be a field, I a small cofiltered category, and D an I-diagram of qcqs schemes over Spec k with affine transition maps. Let c be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, with qcqs structure morphism, and let f:X→Spec k be qcqs. Let F be an abelian etale sheaf on X, q a nonnegative integer, i an index, and (V_t) a finite family of affine etale objects over c.pt. Put P=F[0] and K_i=(c.π_i)^* R(pullback.snd f (D_i.hom))_* (pullback.fst f (D_i.hom))^* P. For every t let z_t:Z[V_t][0]→K_i[q] be a derived morphism, with Z[V_t] the sheafified free abelian representable. If each z_t becomes zero after the canonical cartesian exchange K_i→cartesianDerivedImage f c.pt.hom P, then there exist j and a:j→i such that every z_t becomes zero after the transition K_i→(c.π_j)^*cartesianDerivedImage f (D_j.hom) P, including the canonical inverse-image composition comparison. The notions are those of [def-sc-cartesian-derived-image], [def-sc-cartesian-derived-image-map], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and [def-weil-pbc-sheafification].

source.place: Second proof, part (2), raw cohomology classes; Tags 0EYL and 0GIT for affine etale descent and derived cohomology continuity.

proof.text: Work in the cofiltered category of arrows to the original index i, which has the same limit. Descend each affine etale V_t to an affine etale model over a common stage. Put L_i = cartesianDerivedImage f (D.obj i).hom F[0], a bounded-below complex on D_i. Identify Hom(Z[V_t][0], (c.π_i)^*L_i[q]) with hypercohomology of V_t with these coefficients. Apply derived etale cohomology continuity (0GIT) to the system of models of V_t over D_i with fixed coefficient L_i. Surjectivity of its colimit comparison descends the entire raw class z_t, not just its restrictions on a cover, to a sufficiently late model. Finiteness gives a common stage for these models and representatives.

At a stage model send the descended class through the canonical derived base-change exchange to the cohomology of its cartesian chart X times V_{t,j}. Derived adjunction identifies this with the raw Hom for the stage direct image. These cartesian charts form qcqs inverse systems over X with affine transitions and fixed coefficient F[0]. Apply derived etale cohomology continuity (0GIT) again. The hypothesis says that the limit image of each chart class is zero: exchange pasting identifies its map with z_t followed by the displayed limit exchange. Injectivity of the colimit comparison and the filtered-colimit equality criterion kill each chart class at a later stage. Pullback, adjunction and exchange compatibility identify its pullback to V_t with the required transitioned raw class.

Use IsCofiltered.wideCospan on the finitely many resulting arrows to i, obtaining one arrow to i factoring through each of them. Pull every zero to that common index; functoriality and the inverse-image composition comparisons give exactly the displayed raw transition. For an empty family choose i and its identity. Empty affine test objects have zero hypercohomology, and degree zero uses the same continuity statement. No preservation of injectives by inverse image is used.

theorem exists_cartesianHigherImage_finite_raw_classes_eq_zero
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [∀ i, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom] [∀ i, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget _).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (q : ℕ) (i : I) (J : Type u) [Finite J]
    (V : J → c.pt.left.Etale) [∀ t, IsAffine (V t).left]
    (z : ∀ t, (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      ((abelianComparisonFree c.pt.left).obj (V t)) ⟶
        ((D+(((c.π.app i).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).obj
          (cartesianDerivedImage f (D.obj i).hom
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)))⟦(q : ℤ)⟧)
    (hz : ∀ t, z t ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
      (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj i).hom c.pt.hom (c.π.app i).left
        (Over.w (c.π.app i)).symm ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)) = 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (a : j ⟶ i), ∀ t,
      z t ≫ (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (c.π.app j).left (D.map a).left (c.π.app i).left
          (congrArg (fun b ↦ b.left) (c.w a)).symm).hom.app _ ≫
          (D+(((c.π.app j).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).map
            (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj i).hom (D.obj j).hom
              (D.map a).left (Over.w (D.map a)).symm
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))) = 0
